title: DEPT: Document Embedding Preservation Tuning for Unified Query Expansion and Retrieval
abstract: arXiv:2608.17632v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Large language models (LLMs) can both expand underspecified queries and encode text as dense representations, suggesting a unified model for query expansion and retrieval. Existing systems usually rely on prompted expansions, independently trained modules, or staged optimization, leaving generated expansions only indirectly aligned with the retrieval loss that judges them. We train a single decoder-only LLM end to end, where the same model generates the expansion and encodes both the expanded query and candidate documents. This unified setting creates a moving-target problem: retrieval supervision should improve query-side expansion, but the same update also shifts the document embeddings that serve as retrieval targets. translated_title: 文档嵌入保持微调：统一查询扩展与检索的方法
translated_abstract: arXiv:2608.17632v1 公告类型：交叉 摘要：大型语言模型（LLMs）既能扩展不明确的查询，也能将文本编码为密集表示，这表明一个统一模型可用于查询扩展和检索。现有系统通常依赖于提示式扩展、独立训练的模块或分阶段优化，使得生成的扩展与评估它们的检索损失仅间接对齐。我们端到端训练一个仅解码器的LLM，其中同一模型生成扩展并编码扩展后的查询和候选文档。这种统一设置产生了一个移动目标问题：检索监督应改进查询侧扩展，但同一更新也会改变作为检索目标的文档嵌入。我们引入了文档嵌入保持微调（DEPT），该方法在允许检索梯度通过直通式解码传播的同时，保持微调后的文档嵌入接近缓存的初始嵌入。
tldr: 本文提出DEPT方法，通过保持文档嵌入稳定并允许检索梯度传递，解决了统一查询扩展与检索中因模型更新导致的移动目标问题。
en_tdlr: This paper introduces DEPT, which addresses the moving-target problem in unified query expansion and retrieval by preserving document embeddings while allowing retrieval gradients to flow.
